title: Batch bind collision: make the restart witness real and add a restart-from-unsettled-store positive control
outcome: In src/tests/engram_batch_gate_flow.rs, the verification_bind collision tests prove the restart boundary with a host that has actually booted. A host restarted from a settled store runs run_post_listen_boot with a scripted binding and token, and its owed-binds tick sends no verification_bind. A positive control restarts a host from the trigger-unsettled store of the failed-write test: it sends exactly one verification_bind, identical to the first request under the same key, and then stores the collision settlement durably.
acceptance: Batch bind collision: make the restart witness real and add a restart-from-unsettled-store positive control is done
